summary: Keep Google Workspace Shared Drive EKODI as the canonical durable store for file-like records and final artifacts while using Cloudflare edge controls, cache, rate limiting, R2 delivery/staging and quota circuit breakers to absorb traffic and security pressure.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI on 2026-10-01 to apply the proposed Cloudflare free/edge capabilities with Google Drive used especially for storage and with security and traffic protection.
implementation: config/concurrent-traffic-policy.json 100/1000/10000 traffic tiers and edge protection contract
mandatoryRules: Google Workspace Shared Drive EKODI remains the canonical durable store for file-like records, documents, retained media and final artifacts
Cloudflare R2 is cache, delivery, temporary staging or web mirror only and is not the system of record
D1 or Supabase stores structured operational state and indexes rather than large file bytes
Google Drive API is excluded from public traffic hot paths; hot public delivery uses Cloudflare cache or R2 mirrors
public writes, sensitive writes and authentication use separate Cloudflare edge rate-limit contracts
70/85/90/95/100 percent quota stages progressively conserve, protect, survive and open a circuit breaker
429 and 1027 are stop-retry/circuit-breaker signals for nonessential work
auth, forms, orders, payments, admin control and safe public reads are preserved before noncritical probes, crawlers, detailed analytics and background AI
rollback: Revert the storage/traffic policy commits through the guarded PR path while preserving the existing Drive Storage Gateway, rate-limit bindings and production data. Do not migrate or delete canonical Drive content during rollback.
